observation_note: Read-only observation of the live dirty working tree; no Source files were edited by this lane.

defect_candidates.finding: RepairBuilding changes integrity/condition immediately with no campaign resource, action, or time cost.
A zero-permille repair on a Ruined building can change condition to Damaged while integrity remains zero.
FSoulTownRules::AdvanceDay takes one settlement but calls global campaign AdvanceDay; naïve multi-town iteration can advance day/income more than once.
RecruitmentPools are keyed globally by UnitId rather than settlement+unit, conflicting with independent local finite pools in a multi-town campaign.
Encirclement reduces defender supply to a floor of 200, but current siege rules do not connect low supply to surrender, attrition, combat power, readiness, or attacker upkeep.
SeizeExposedRegion has no readiness/recovery penalty, unlike capture/attack and unlike the Living Strategy donor seam.
Siege aftermath persists wall/building damage and scars but currently defines no attacker upkeep, occupation transfer cost, income disruption, or repair-resource consequence.

PrerequisitesMet rejects Ruined prerequisites but does not require the prerequisite to meet the operational integrity threshold; a Damaged near-zero-integrity prerequisite can still unlock construction.
